description: MimikFlow helps existing customers launch and manage automated B2B prospecting from their AI assistant. They can review results and conversations, handle drafts and escalations, adjust campaign settings, and add selected prospects while MimikFlow preserves the account's plan, permissions, and outreach safety limits.
